newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiei shares down on glum profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Daiei shares down on glum profit forecast.

text.p: Shares in Daiei Inc were down in early morning Monday trade, depressed by a glum earnings forecast in the business year to March 31, 1997, brokers said.
As of 0039 GMT, the shares were down 40 yen at 1,000 yen, with a trade volume of 862,000 shares, ranking third on the list of largest trade by volume.

On Friday, Daiei said it had halved its forecast for parent current profit for the current year to 13 billion yen from its previous forecast. Daiei's actual parent current profit in 1995/96 was 25.04 billion yen.
